Every option you are given is already approved for this part and can deliver in time; you are not checking those things again. Weigh unit price against delivery reliability, and remember that this order exists because a line is about to stop — the cheapest option is not automatically the right one when a supplier's on-time record is poor. Justify your choice in two sentences.
